what.text: This page follows refugees from Azerbaijan living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6797 Azerbaijani refugees in Germany, 5.2% of all refugees from Azerbaijan.
Armenia hosts the most Azerbaijani refugees, followed by Germany, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh) territory in Azerbaijan in periods from 1997 to 2023.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Azerbaijan.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 7405 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 9150, at the end of 2004.
It fell to a low in 2013 and rose again; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2005, 2008 to 2012 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
